accepted_change: Expose process-lifetime exact-response cache counters without recording request content.

counter_contract.hits: requests served immediately from an exact validated response
counter_contract.misses: requests whose exact response was absent when they arrived, including coalesced followers
counter_contract.stores: validated leader responses inserted into the bounded cache
counter_contract.evictions: least-recently-used entries removed because the cache was full
counter_contract.coalesced: cache misses that waited for an identical in-flight leader
counter_contract.coalesce_timeouts: identical followers that exceeded the bounded wait
counter_contract.coalesce_reuse_failures: identical followers whose leader produced no reusable response
counter_contract.busy_rejections: different uncached requests rejected while inference was occupied

boundary: This round makes cache and contention behavior measurable. It does not reduce cold inference latency or prove new-dataset generalization. Cache policy changes require measured eviction and contention evidence from real workflows.
